mcp.title: MCP setup
mcp.intro: TMGR MCP uses the smart device token as a custom header. Generate the token above, then configure an MCP client that supports remote Streamable HTTP servers with headers (Claude Code: {command}).
mcp.oauth: OAuth note: this TMGR MCP server is not an OAuth connector yet. Unlike Spendly, it authenticates `/mcp/**` with `X-Smart-Device-Token`, so Claude.ai custom connectors that require OAuth discovery are not supported by this setup.
mcp.notify: This MCP works with your tasks and time. For phone notifications and alarms from agents, connect tmgr-notify in {link}.

agentUsage.title: Agent work
agentUsage.description: Show what AI agents cost on your tasks, on every device.
agentUsage.syncDescription: Uploads per-task totals so web and mobile can show them: tokens, AI cost (API-equivalent), agent, model and tool names, and counts. Never prompts, replies, file paths or command arguments. Uploads start only from the tmgr CLI, after you turn them on there: by hand with `tmgr usage sync`, or after each agent run if you also confirm `tmgr usage sync auto on`. Turning it off deletes everything already uploaded.
agentUsage.unavailable: Agent usage sync is not available on this server yet.
agentUsage.uploadsDescription: What this account has uploaded, newest first.
agentUsage.turnOffBody: Everything this account has uploaded is deleted from TMGR. You can turn it on again later.
agentUsage.deleteBody: Everything this account has uploaded is deleted from TMGR. Agent usage sync stays as it is.
